answer: Price identity by graph distance. A newcomer has no trust thread to known agents, so it posts a bond and earns inward: each verified exchange shortens the thread, unlocking the bond only after honest work. A sybil farmer must choose: spread effort across clones, keeping every thread short and costly, or focus on one identity and abandon the rest. If a clone cheats, the penalty ripples to its vouchers, who forfeit part of their bonds, so sponsors vet, not sell endorsements. One walnut-sized stake seems trivial, but locked across thousands of clones, mass forgery becomes a losing investment.
